name: factionoptions
description: Real-time CV and MIDI collaboration over WebRTC P2P connections
author: Jason Soares

modules.name: Resonance Hub
modules.description: Control center for Resonance network - QR authentication, room selection, peer management
modules.keywords: WebRTC P2P network collaboration room peer

modules.name: CV Peer
modules.description: Bidirectional CV connection to a peer - 4 inputs (send), 4 outputs (receive), gate output
modules.keywords: network CV voltage control remote collaboration send receive

modules.name: MIDI I/O
modules.description: Hardware MIDI adapter for CV Peer - 4 ports with hardware device routing
modules.keywords: MIDI hardware routing adapter I/O send receive

modules.name: Resonance Monitor
modules.description: Debug monitor for ResonanceHub - displays connection state, peer info, data flow, and diagnostics
modules.keywords: debug diagnostics connection state peer info data flow

modules.name: Net CV
modules.description: Network conditions as CV - latency, packet loss, peer count, connection state
modules.keywords: network latency packet loss jitter metrics monitoring

modules.name: CV Mix
modules.description: Averaged mix bus for peer receive CV - sums and averages CV from all connected peers
modules.keywords: mix bus average sum CV peer receive aggregate
